body:
On 2026-10-21, the owner requested: "Then, do another round, Your goal is to add end-to-end integration tests which identify bugs (the tests should initially fail), and then fix the bug in the implementation." This addresses https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/jvm-libp2p/issues/62: an explicit read on a paused child stream did not deliver data already queued.

An explicit read now delivers one queued payload and read-complete while auto-read remains disabled, or waits for the next payload. Pending requests coalesce. Callback reads continue without nested callbacks, and Mplex re-arms its paused transport after a resume callback requests more data. The child config handles automatic resume separately so a delayed automatic read cannot be mistaken for explicit demand. Existing receive limits, receive-credit accounting, EOF order and close cleanup remain in effect.

Validation:

- The original real TCP/Noise reproduction failed for both Mplex and Yamux before the fix. All 11 initial cases failed their first baseline runtime attempt. Review then added an empty-queue callback case that initially failed for Mplex.
- All 13 new cases plus 68 neighbours passed on the first attempt in three focused runs, and all 81 passed again in the full suite. Coverage includes 8,000 reads from eight concurrent callers, one-byte transport reads, EOF, callback close, receive bounds, backing storage, sibling progress and teardown.
- Formatting, static analysis and library assembly passed in the prior lane. This verification lane changes no implementation or test source.
- The full root command `./gradlew --no-daemon cleanTest test --continue` ran once under the shared machine lock. It completed in **5m 28s: 1,286 tests, 1,267 passed, 17 failed, 2 existing disabled cases skipped**. The library module contributed 1,259 tests and the simulator 27 passing tests. Fresh XML contained no stale reports. The command exited 1 because of test failures; it was not killed or retried.
- Shared cgroup memory was 8,003,457,024 bytes before execution; the observer sampled a peak of 10,736,848,896 bytes. The cgroup oom_kill count stayed at 1.

The comparison uses PR head [091b6d17](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/jvm-libp2p/commit/091b6d17280045ec2a1260ec890d1a06991bb6ac) and unchanged develop [bd7edb25](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/jvm-libp2p/commit/bd7edb2570fb609c20245305c25af29d166a67c6). Every failing case ran alone on both versions, including each parameter invocation: **34 test executions, one test started per JVM, zero skips, aborts or retries**. Twelve fail on both versions and five pass on both when isolated. For every full-run binding failure, a real listener was then held at 127.0.0.1:40002: all 16 controls failed on both versions with the exact `java.net.BindException: Address already in use`.

All 17 failures are reproduced on develop, either alone or under that same occupied-port condition. **No PR-specific failure was identified.** This replaces the earlier unverified 20-case baseline claim with individual comparisons; it does not claim a full-suite count for develop.

`TLS` below means `javax.net.ssl.SSLException: failed to create an SSL_CTX`. `Bind` means the exact BindException above. The occupied-port column shows develop / PR.

The binding cases use fixed port 40002 in [TwoGossipHostTestBase](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/jvm-libp2p/blob/bd7edb2570fb609c20245305c25af29d166a67c6/libp2p/src/test/kotlin/io/libp2p/pubsub/gossip/TwoGossipHostTestBase.kt#L39) and [HostTestJava](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/jvm-libp2p/blob/bd7edb2570fb609c20245305c25af29d166a67c6/libp2p/src/test/java/io/libp2p/core/HostTestJava.java#L225). The original full-run owner of that port was not established; the controls directly reproduce the observed OS condition. The native TLS failures reach `SSLContext.make`; no lower-level native-library cause is claimed. The Kubo case expects an API at localhost:5001 and gets connection refused on both versions.

The two skipped cases already have Disabled annotations on develop: `EchoSampleTest.connect1` and `QuicServerTestJava.checkConnectionIsNotClosedByTimeout`. No test annotation, timeout, iteration count or assertion was changed.

GitHub Actions remains at **startup_failure with zero jobs created**, so there is no Actions code/test verdict: https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/jvm-libp2p/actions/runs/39899535098 . Both successful Kotlin checks explicitly report no build.kts and ran no Gradle tests. They are informational for this verification. No CI rerun was requested. This PR remains **draft**, as requested.

Current counts, classifications and reproducible helper source: https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/jvm-libp2p/tree/wip/JL62b-evidence-20261023/lane-evidence .
